# Hello World Cards
> Pokémon cards from Sam and Timo — listed here and on Marktplaats. Handpainted binders come with us to events.

Hello World Cards is a small Pokémon shop run by Sam and Timo. We list cards here and on Marktplaats (https://www.marktplaats.nl/u/hello-world-cards/25399885/), and we bring handpainted binders to events. Email helloworldcards@outlook.com about a card, an event, or anything else.

## Pages
- [Home](https://helloworldcards.com/): Pokémon cards from Sam and Timo — listed here and on Marktplaats. Handpainted binders come with us to events.
- [Shop](https://helloworldcards.com/products): Browse Pokémon cards listed here and on Marktplaats.
- [Upcoming events](https://helloworldcards.com/agenda): We'll be at these Pokémon events. Come say hi, browse the stall, and have a look at Sam's binders.
- [About](https://helloworldcards.com/about): We're Sam and Timo, a couple of programmers who turned a Pokémon hobby into Hello World Cards.
- [Contact](https://helloworldcards.com/contact): Questions about a card, an event, or anything else? Send us a message.

## FAQ
### What is Hello World Cards?
A small Pokémon shop run by Sam and Timo. We list cards here and on Marktplaats, and we bring handpainted binders to events.

### Who runs Hello World Cards?
Sam and Timo, a couple of programmers who collect Pokémon. Sam collects Wooper and Quagsire and paints the binders. Timo chases Gengar and Ralts.

### Do you have a physical shop?
No walk-in storefront. We sell cards online and on Marktplaats, and in person at Pokémon events in the Netherlands and Belgium.

### What do you sell?
Pokémon cards, including graded cards, listed here and on Marktplaats. Sam's custom handpainted binders come with us to events.

### How do I buy a card?
Cards are listed here and on Marktplaats (https://www.marktplaats.nl/u/hello-world-cards/25399885/). If the product page has a Marktplaats link, that's the listing. If it doesn't, email us at helloworldcards@outlook.com. You can always email about anything.

### How can I get in touch?
Email, the contact form, Instagram @helloworldcards, or our Marktplaats page.

### Where can I meet you in person?
At the events on the agenda. We bring a stall with cards and Sam's handpainted binders.

## Products
- [Mewtwo Reverse Holo](https://helloworldcards.com/products/mewtwo-reverse-holo-2016-xy-evolutions-51-108): 2016 XY Evolutions - 51/108. €99. Reverse holo Mewtwo from the 2016 XY Evolutions set, number 51/108. Graded PSA 9 Mint.
- [Blastoise Holo](https://helloworldcards.com/products/blastoise-holo-base-set-reverse-holo-10-102): Base Set - Reverse Holo - 10/102. €189. A reverse holo Blastoise from Base Set. Classic art, the kind of card that still earns a page in the binder.
- [Venusaur Holo](https://helloworldcards.com/products/venusaur-holo-base-set-10-102): Base Set - 10/102. €159. Holo Venusaur from Base Set. Grass-type staple with the original full-art energy.
- [Pikachu Illustrator](https://helloworldcards.com/products/pikachu-illustrator-base-set-10-102): Base Set - 10/102. €1.200. Pikachu Illustrator — a display piece. Ask us if you want a closer look.
- [Mewtwo GX](https://helloworldcards.com/products/mewtwo-gx-base-set-10-102): Base Set - 10/102. €79. Mewtwo GX from the shop. A later-era hit that still pulls focus in a binder.
- [Eevee Promo](https://helloworldcards.com/products/eevee-promo-base-set-10-102): Base Set - 10/102. An Eevee promo with the soft art people pick up and don’t put back.
